answer: The design leans on diversity requirement on juries, published publicly on failure, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. The anchor holds work receipts rather than names, so the plume of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the ridge of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short.
